label: Superhero city
blurb: A comic-book metropolis of capes and secret identities: vigilantes, scientists, reporters and the villains who keep them busy.
context: comic book superhero city character, bold and dynamic
negative: Superman logo, S-shield, DC Comics logo, Marvel Comics logo, real comic book character, existing superhero costume, copyrighted logo, trademarked emblem
hobbies: sketching villains from the evening news
growing tomatoes on the fire escape
sketching blueprints for gadgets no one asked for
quirks: never quite meeting {poss} own eyes in the mirror
flinching at loud bangs from old habit
keeping a go-bag by the door
talking {poss} way out of trouble a little too smoothly
humming the evening news jingle without noticing
never eating the same lunch two days running
watching the sky more than the sidewalk
keeping a spare change of clothes at work, just in case
flinching whenever a helicopter passes over
goals: finding out who's really behind the break-ins downtown
getting a full night's sleep for once
proving {subj} is more than a sidekick
affording a real lab of {poss} own
clearing {poss} name after the papers got it wrong
making it home in one piece before sunrise
finding a cure before it's too late
peeves: reporters who never check their facts
a city council that won't fund anything
knockoff gadgets that fall apart mid-fight
people who don't believe {obj} at all
a mask that won't stay put
getting blamed for the collateral damage
accessories: a press badge on a lanyard
a pair of tinted goggles pushed up on the forehead
a small lapel pin from an old team
a cracked smartphone with too many notifications
a locket with an old photograph
a police scanner clipped to the belt
a notebook full of half-finished blueprints
